scope: Read-only palette and deterministic-round feedback before a resident frame commits state
tolerance_reason: Only exact unsigned integer decisions; no floating point arithmetic.
preconditions: ContactPlan bound fits allocated colors and links; native len offsets are derived from Rust.
Only link length and active color are read. Body IDs may be stale and are never dereferenced.
invariants: Maximum active color is exact; values >=64 return UINT_MAX to force explicit exhaustion.
Any active zero requests one additional round, saturating at UINT_MAX. Inactive links are ignored.
All inputs and output words after the two counters remain bitwise unchanged.
